name: media_objects
description: One stored file of a company on the media volume, named by the SHA-256 of its bytes: an original upload, a display rendition or a thumbnail. Identical bytes are stored once per company and never shared across companies.
lifecycle: Inserted when a file is published into the volume, under this row's lock, before the referencing asset commits. Deleted by purge, with the file, once no asset of the company references it. Rows never change.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the object; part of the key so objects never cross tenants.
SHA-256 of the object's bytes; with the company it names the file on the media volume.
Server-determined media type of the stored file, sent when it is delivered.
PostgreSQL-clock instant the object was first stored.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: An object belongs to an existing company.
One row per company and content hash.
The key is a SHA-256 digest.
